_note: The mix (src/audio/audio_mix.gd). buses: created at start under Master with a base level in dB; the player's sliders scale them (Gesamt = Master, Musik = Music and Ambience, Effekte = SFX and UI). Focus is a part of SFX for the sounds you must never miss (your hero is hit, perks, stingers); the Music and Ambience buses duck under it (sidechain compressor: threshold in dB, ratio, attack in microseconds, release in ms). limiter keeps the Master below ceiling_db. categories: every sound event names one; it decides the bus and a level in dB, so sounds sit at different heights (your hero first, enemies and steps lower). Final level of a sound = base_db + category volume_db + event volume_db + the file's gain_db from audio_library.json.
